membership: Per market, intersect the frozen opportunities with EVALUATED outcomes for every preregistered family, both directions and both sensitivities; all candidates use this exact same membership, point-in-time features and chronological split.
excluded_outcomes: Ambiguous or unverifiable outcomes are excluded from the identical comparison cohort and reported by count, never assigned a return.
markets: Only markets with at least 30 common complete opportunities may enter. Germany 40 remains reported as ineligible.
target: For each policy family, choose LONG, SHORT or NO_TRADE by maximum observed NORMAL_P75 net return in the development training partition only; ties favor NO_TRADE, then LONG.
split: Sort by decision_at_utc then opportunity_id; last 30 percent is development assessment, first 70 percent is training. Purge training rows whose 120-minute outcome horizon touches the first assessment decision. Require at least 30 training and 15 assessment opportunities.
assessment: For predicted trades, report NORMAL_P75 and STRESSED_P95 net expectancy, profit factor, max compounded drawdown and trade count on the same assessment rows; report NO_TRADE count. No profitability claim follows from development alone.
development_selection: At most one family/model per market, only if normal and stressed PF exceed 1, normal and stressed trade expectancy exceed 0 and at least 10 assessment trades. Choose highest stressed expectancy; ties use stressed PF then model and family ID. Zero qualifying candidates means no selection.
